summary: @ornikar/rollup-plugin-postcss ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: Package impersonates the legitimate `rollup-plugin-postcss` (reusing upstream name, author, repository and dist bundle) under an unrelated `@ornikar` scope, and adds a `preinstall` hook absent upstream. `package.json` declares `scripts.preinstall: "node setup.mjs"`; `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime binary (oven-sh/bun v1.3.13) from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and `execFileSync`s it against the sibling file `math_init.js` (falling back to any system `bun` with no verification). `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (marked `// @bun @bun-cjs`, `_0x`-style identifiers, shuffled string/number array with a `WV8StW` rotator) that is not referenced by the advertised PostCSS/Rollup functionality in `dist/index.js` and is invoked only by the preinstall dropper. The `files` field declares only `dist` yet the tarball ships `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js`. Installing this package causes an alternate runtime to be fetched and used to run obfuscated code on the installer's machine at `npm install` time, outside the normal Node-resolved code path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
